Gates.intro: Each milestone is a checkpoint: it is computed from its criteria and, once ready, someone with authority approves it. Approval freezes the evidence at that moment. If it later stops complying (e.g. an ITR is reopened), it is flagged as regressed instead of being revoked automatically, and it holds the next milestone. A punch raised after approval does not regress the milestone: it holds the next one.
